plugins.name: nerf-check
plugins.description: Did the model get worse, or was it just a bad week? Measures a Claude model's behaviour in your own Claude Code work from local transcripts: judged correction rate with intervals, thinking and tool use, models side by side, and review-bot and pre-push review outcomes per model. Builds a weekly dashboard.
